local enhance_common = require("abilities.enhance.enhance_common")

local METEOR_ROLL_PARTICLE = "particles/units/heroes/hero_invoker/invoker_chaos_meteor.vpcf"
local DEBUG_ENHANCE = false

LinkLuaModifier("modifier_invoker_chaos_meteor_enhance",
    "abilities/enhance/invoker_chaos_meteor.lua", LUA_MODIFIER_MOTION_NONE)

local FIREBALL_PARTICLE = "particles/units/heroes/hero_jakiro/jakiro_base_attack_fire.vpcf"
local FIREBALL_IMPACT_PARTICLE = "particles/spell/shredder_scepter_explode_fire.vpcf"

-- 已提取到 enhance_common

local function ApplyMeteorBurn(owner, ability, target, burn_dps, burn_duration, damage_scale, pure_percent, interval)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if not target or target:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    burn_dps = tonumber(burn_dps) or 0
    burn_duration = tonumber(burn_duration) or 0
    if burn_dps <= 0 or burn_duration <= 0 then
        return
    end
    target:AddNewModifier(owner, ability, "modifier_invoker_chaos_meteor_burn", {
        duration = burn_duration,
    })
end

local function RollSubMeteor(owner, ability, projectile_ability, start_pos, dir, distance, speed, radius, damage_interval,
                             damage_params)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if not start_pos or not dir then
        return
    end
    if distance <= 0 or speed <= 0 then
        return
    end

    local travel_time = distance / speed
    local main_damage = tonumber(ability and ability.GetSpecialValueFor and ability:GetSpecialValueFor("main_damage") or
        0) or 0
    local burn_dps = tonumber(ability and ability.GetSpecialValueFor and ability:GetSpecialValueFor("burn_dps") or 0) or
        0
    local burn_duration = tonumber(ability and ability.GetSpecialValueFor and ability:GetSpecialValueFor("burn_duration") or
        0) or 0
    local kv_interval = tonumber(ability and ability.GetSpecialValueFor and ability:GetSpecialValueFor("damage_interval") or
        0) or 0
    local dmg_interval = math.max(kv_interval > 0 and kv_interval or (damage_interval or 0.5), 0.05)
    local damage_scale = damage_params and damage_params.damage_scale or 1
    local pure_percent = damage_params and damage_params.pure_percent or 0
    local base_damage = main_damage + (damage_params and damage_params.base_damage or 0)

    local visual_source_dummy = nil
    local visual_source_idx = nil
    if METEOR_ROLL_PARTICLE and METEOR_ROLL_PARTICLE ~= "" then
        if DEBUG_ENHANCE then
            print(string.format(
                "[MeteorEnhance] SubMeteor | Start: (%.1f, %.1f) | Dir: (%.2f, %.2f)",
                start_pos.x, start_pos.y, dir.x, dir.y
            ))
        end
        visual_source_dummy = enhance_common.AcquireTrackingTarget(owner:GetTeamNumber())
        if visual_source_dummy and not visual_source_dummy:IsNull() then
            visual_source_dummy:SetAbsOrigin(start_pos)
            if visual_source_dummy.SetForwardVector then
                visual_source_dummy:SetForwardVector(dir)
            end
            visual_source_idx = visual_source_dummy:entindex()
            enhance_common.ReleaseTrackingTargetDelayed(visual_source_idx, travel_time + 0.2)
        end
    end

    local ability_for_projectile = projectile_ability or ability
    if ability_for_projectile and not ability_for_projectile:IsNull() then
        Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
            if not owner or owner:IsNull() then
                return nil
            end
            local spawn_pos = start_pos
            if visual_source_idx then
                local vs = EntIndexToHScript(visual_source_idx)
                if vs and not vs:IsNull() then
                    spawn_pos = vs:GetAbsOrigin()
                end
            end
            local visual_info = {
                Ability = ability_for_projectile,
                EffectName = METEOR_ROLL_PARTICLE,
                vSpawnOrigin = spawn_pos,
                fDistance = distance,
                fStartRadius = radius,
                fEndRadius = radius,
                Source = owner,
                bHasFrontalCone = false,
                bReplaceExisting = false,
                iUnitTargetTeam = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
                iUnitTargetFlags = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
                iUnitTargetType = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
                bDeleteOnHit = false,
                vVelocity = dir * speed,
                bProvidesVision = false,
                ExtraData = {
                    owner_entindex = owner:entindex(),
                    main_damage = base_damage,
                    damage_scale = damage_scale,
                    pure_percent = pure_percent,
                    burn_dps = burn_dps,
                    burn_duration = burn_duration,
                    burn_interval = 1.0,
                    enhance_uid = damage_params and damage_params.enhance_uid,
                    enhance_root_uid = damage_params and damage_params.enhance_root_uid,
                }
            }
            ProjectileManager:CreateLinearProjectile(visual_info)
            return nil
        end)
    end

    local tick = 0.03
    local elapsed = 0
    local hit_timers = {}
    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        if not owner or owner:IsNull() then
            return nil
        end
        if elapsed >= travel_time then
            return nil
        end

        local pos = start_pos + dir * math.min(distance, speed * elapsed)
        local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
            owner:GetTeamNumber(),
            pos,
            nil,
            radius,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
            FIND_ANY_ORDER,
            false
        )
        local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
            if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() and enemy:IsAlive() then
                local idx = enemy:entindex()
                if now >= (hit_timers[idx] or 0) then
                    enhance_common.ApplyProjectileDamage(owner, enemy, {
                        base_damage = base_damage,
                        damage_scale = damage_scale,
                        pure_percent = pure_percent,
                        ability = ability,
                    })
                    ApplyMeteorBurn(owner, ability, enemy, burn_dps, burn_duration, damage_scale, pure_percent, 1.0)
                    hit_timers[idx] = now + dmg_interval
                end
            end
        end

        elapsed = elapsed + tick
        return tick
    end)
end

local function ResolveAutocastMod(caster, owner)
    if caster and not caster:IsNull() then
        local mod = caster:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
        if mod then
            return mod
        end
        local source_idx = caster.__autocast_source_dummy
        if source_idx then
            local source = EntIndexToHScript(source_idx)
            if source and not source:IsNull() then
                mod = source:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
                if mod then
                    return mod
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if owner and not owner:IsNull() then
        local mod = owner:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
        if mod then
            return mod
        end
        local source_idx = owner.__autocast_source_dummy
        if source_idx then
            local source = EntIndexToHScript(source_idx)
            if source and not source:IsNull() then
                mod = source:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
                if mod then
                    return mod
                end
            end
        end
    end

local function ParsePercent(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    local num = string.match(s, "^([%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%%%s*$")
    if num then

    end
    return tonumber(s)

    if not vec then

    end
    local v = Vector(vec.x, vec.y, 0)
    local len = v:Length2D()
    if len <= 0.0001 then
        return Vector(0, 1, 0)
    end
    return Vector(v.x / len, v.y / len, 0)
end

    if not caster or caster:IsNull() or not owner or owner:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
        owner:GetTeamNumber(),
        origin,
        nil,
        radius,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
        FIND_ANY_ORDER,
        false
    )
    if not enemies or #enemies == 0 then
        return
    end
    local dist = tonumber(distance) or 0
    local dur = tonumber(duration) or 0
    if dist <= 0 or dur <= 0 then
        return
    end

    local raw = enhance_common.GetPassiveRawValue(ab, key)

    local fx = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(name, PATTACH_WORLDORIGIN, nil)

local enhance_common = require("abilities.enhance.enhance_common")

LinkLuaModifier("modifier_crystal_maiden_ice_burst_slow",
    "abilities/crystal_maiden_ice_burst.lua", LUA_MODIFIER_MOTION_NONE)

local ICE_BURST_MAIN_PARTICLE = "particles/units/heroes/hero_crystalmaiden/maiden_crystal_nova.vpcf"
local ICE_BURST_HIT_PARTICLE = "particles/units/heroes/hero_crystalmaiden/maiden_crystal_nova_impact.vpcf"
local ICE_BURST_FADE_TIME = 0
local ICE_BURST_CLONE_PARTICLE = "particles/units/heroes/hero_crystalmaiden/maiden_frostbite_buff_base.vpcf"
local DEBUG_HIGHEST_ICE_MAGE = false
local ICE_BURST_BLOCKER_UNIT = "npc_dota_wall_dummy"
local ICE_BURST_BLOCKER_RADIUS = 80
local ICE_BURST_REPULSE_DURATION = 0.3

local function ParsePercent(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    local num = string.match(s, "^([%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%%%s*$")
    if num then
        return tonumber(num)
    end
    return tonumber(s)
end

local function Normalize2D(vec)
    if not vec then
        return Vector(0, 1, 0)
    end
    local v = Vector(vec.x, vec.y, 0)
    local len = v:Length2D()
    if len <= 0.0001 then
        return Vector(0, 1, 0)
    end
    return Vector(v.x / len, v.y / len, 0)
end

local function ApplyIceBurstRepulse(caster, ability, owner, origin, radius, distance, duration)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() or not owner or owner:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
        owner:GetTeamNumber(),
        origin,
        nil,
        radius,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
        FIND_ANY_ORDER,
        false
    )
    if not enemies or #enemies == 0 then
        return
    end
    local dist = tonumber(distance) or 0
    local dur = tonumber(duration) or 0
    if dist <= 0 or dur <= 0 then
        return
    end
    for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
        if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
            local dir = Normalize2D(enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - origin)
            local center = enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - dir
            enemy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_knockback")
            enemy:AddNewModifier(caster, ability, "modifier_knockback", {
                should_stun = 0,
                knockback_duration = dur,
                duration = dur,
                knockback_distance = dist,
                knockback_height = 0,
                center_x = center.x,
                center_y = center.y,
                center_z = center.z,
            })
            if SpawnWallManager and SpawnWallManager.ScheduleNeutralRepulseUpdate then
                SpawnWallManager:ScheduleNeutralRepulseUpdate(enemy, dur)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function CreateIceBurstBlocker(owner, origin, radius, duration)
    if not IsServer() or not owner or owner:IsNull() or not origin then
        return
    end
    local blocker = CreateUnitByName(ICE_BURST_BLOCKER_UNIT, origin, false, owner, owner, owner:GetTeamNumber())
    if not blocker then
        return
    end
    blocker:SetAbsOrigin(origin)
    if blocker.SetHullRadius then
        blocker:SetHullRadius(radius)
    end
    blocker:AddNoDraw()
    blocker:AddNewModifier(blocker, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    blocker:AddNewModifier(blocker, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    blocker:AddNewModifier(blocker, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
    blocker:AddNewModifier(blocker, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
    if Physics and blocker.AddColliderFromProfile then
        local collider = blocker:AddColliderFromProfile("blocker", {
            radius = radius,
            buffer = 0,
            recollideTime = 0,
            skipFrames = 0,
            moveSelf = false,
            findClearSpace = true,
            test = function(self, collider_unit, collided)
                if not collided or collided:IsNull() then
                    return false
                end
                if not collided.GetTeamNumber then
                    return false
                end
                local col_team = collider_unit.GetTeamNumber and collider_unit:GetTeamNumber() or
                    (collider_unit.GetTeam and collider_unit:GetTeam() or -1)
                return col_team ~= collided:GetTeamNumber()
            end,
            action = function(self, unit, v)
                Physics:BlockInSphere(unit, v, self.radius + (self.buffer or 0), true)
            end,
        })
        blocker.__ice_burst_collider = collider
    end
    Timers:CreateTimer(duration, function()
        if blocker and IsValidEntity(blocker) then
            if blocker.RemoveCollider and blocker.__ice_burst_collider then
                blocker:RemoveCollider(blocker.__ice_burst_collider)

local function SelectEnemyByCareer(profile, enemies, origin)

local function ComputeCareerDamageBonus(profile, enemy, origin)
    if not profile or not enemy or enemy:IsNull() then
        return 0, nil, 0
    end
    local career = NormalizeCareer(profile.career)
    if not career then
        return 0, nil, 0
    end
    local cfg = GetCareerConfigTable(career)
    local dist = origin and (enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - origin):Length2D() or 0
    local is_boss = IsBossUnit(enemy) and 1 or 0
    if not cfg then
        return 0, dist, is_boss
    end
    local bonus = 0
    local career_key = string.lower(career)
    if career_key == "warrior" then
        local range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_range", "BonusRange", "Range", "range" }) or 0
        local pct = ReadCareerPct(cfg,
            { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        if range > 0 and dist <= range then
            bonus = pct
        end
    elseif career_key == "ranged" then
        local min_range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_min_range", "BonusMinRange", "MinRange", "min_range" }) or 0
        local max_range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_max_range", "BonusMaxRange", "MaxRange", "max_range" }) or 0
        local max_bonus = ReadCareerPct(cfg,
            { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        if max_range > min_range and dist > min_range then
            local t = math.min(1, (dist - min_range) / (max_range - min_range))
            bonus = max_bonus * t
        elseif dist >= max_range and max_range > 0 then
            bonus = max_bonus
        end
    elseif career_key == "control" then
        local requires_boss = ReadCareerBool(cfg,
            { "requires_boss", "RequiresBoss", "BossOnly", "boss_only", "IsBoss", "is_boss" })
        if requires_boss == 0 then
            requires_boss = 1
        end
        if requires_boss == 1 and is_boss == 1 then
            bonus = ReadCareerPct(cfg,
                { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        end
    elseif career_key == "mage" then
        profile.career_crit_chance_bonus_pct = ReadCareerPct(cfg, {
            "crit_chance_bonus_pct",
            "CritChanceBonusPct",
            "CritChancePct",
            "crit_chance_pct",
        }) or 0
    end
    return bonus, dist, is_boss
end

local function AcquireDummySp(self, origin)
    local pid = -1
    local owner = self.owner or self.parent
    if owner and not owner:IsNull() then
        pid = owner:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    end

    local category = GetItemCategory(self.ability)
    local pool_key = tostring(pid) .. "_" .. category

    DummySpPools[pool_key] = DummySpPools[pool_key] or {}
    local pool = DummySpPools[pool_key]

    for i = #pool, 1, -1 do
        local dummy = pool[i]
        if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
            table.remove(pool, i)
        end
    end

    for _, dummy in ipairs(pool) do
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() and dummy:IsAlive() and not IsUnitBusy(dummy) then
            return PrepareDummySp(self, dummy, origin)
        end
    end

    if not owner or owner:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end

    local dummy = CreateUnitByName(
        DUMMY_SP_UNIT_NAME,
        origin or owner:GetAbsOrigin(),
        false,
        owner,
        owner,
        owner:GetTeamNumber()
    )

    if not dummy then
        return nil
    end

    table.insert(pool, dummy)
    return PrepareDummySp(self, dummy, origin)
end

    if not unit or unit:IsNull() or not pos then return end
    if unit.__enhance_busy then
        if DEBUG_CAST then
            print(string.format("[Autocast] SafeSetFacing BLOCKED by Busy Lock | Unit: %s", unit:GetUnitName()))
        end
        return
    end -- Locked by external enhancement (Volley/Combo)

    -- FORCE INSTANT TURN: FaceTowards is too slow (depends on turn rate).
    -- For accurate projectiles, we must snap the vector immediately before casting.
    local origin = unit:GetAbsOrigin()
    local dir = (pos - origin):Normalized()
    dir.z = 0
    if dir:Length2D() > 0.01 then
        local fwd = dir:Normalized()
        if unit.SetForwardVector then
            unit:SetForwardVector(fwd)
        end
        -- Fallback to FaceTowards for animation system or client-side interpolation
        if unit.FaceTowards then
            unit:FaceTowards(pos)
        end
    end

    -- Only sync visual for parent
    if unit == self.parent then
        SyncVisualFacing(unit, pos)
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnAttackRecord(keys)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not keys or keys.attacker ~= self.parent then
        return
    end
    local entry = nil
    if self.pending_attack_records and keys.record and self.pending_attack_records[keys.record] then
        entry = self.pending_attack_records[keys.record]
        self.pending_attack_records[keys.record] = nil
    elseif self.pending_attack_profiles and #self.pending_attack_profiles > 0 then
        entry = table.remove(self.pending_attack_profiles, 1)
    end
    if not entry then
        if _G.DEBUG_ENHANCE_UID then
            print(string.format("[EnhanceUID][AttackRecord] attacker=%s record=%s entry=nil q=%s",
                tostring(self.parent:entindex()),
                tostring(keys.record),
                tostring(self.pending_attack_profiles and #self.pending_attack_profiles or 0)))
        end
        return
    end
    local profile = entry.profile or entry
    if not profile then
        return
    end
    self.attack_records = self.attack_records or {}
    self.attack_records[tostring(keys.record)] = {
        profile = profile,
        enhance_uid = entry.enhance_uid,
        enhance_root_uid = entry.enhance_root_uid,

    if enhance_common and enhance_common.StoreEnhanceRecord and entry.enhance_uid then
        enhance_common.StoreEnhanceRecord(self.parent, keys.record, entry.enhance_uid, entry.enhance_root_uid)
    end

    if enhance_common and enhance_common.HandleEnhanceAttackStart then
        enhance_common.HandleEnhanceAttackStart({
            attacker = self.parent,
            target = keys.target,
            record = keys.record,
            attack_record = keys.record,

            enhance_root_uid = entry.enhance_root_uid,
            skip_volley = entry.skip_volley,
            skip_combo = entry.skip_combo,

    end
    if _G.DEBUG_ENHANCE_UID then
        print(string.format("[EnhanceUID][AttackRecord] attacker=%s name=%s record=%s uid=%s root=%s",
            tostring(self.parent:entindex()),
            tostring(self.parent.GetUnitName and self.parent:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
            tostring(keys.record),
            tostring(entry.enhance_uid),
            tostring(entry.enhance_root_uid)))
    end
end

local function SelectClosestEnemy(enemies, origin)
    if not enemies or #enemies == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local best = nil
    local best_dist = nil
    for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
        if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
            local dist = (enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - origin):Length2D()
            if not best or dist < best_dist then
                best = enemy
                best_dist = dist
            end
        end
    end
    return best or enemies[1]
end

local function SelectEnemyByCareer(profile, enemies, origin)
    if not enemies or #enemies == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    enemies = FilterEnemiesByAngle(profile, enemies, origin)
    if not enemies or #enemies == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local career = profile and NormalizeCareer(profile.career) or nil
    if not career then
        return SelectClosestEnemy(enemies, origin)
    end
    local career_key = string.lower(career)
    if career_key == "control" then
        local best = nil
        local best_dist = nil
        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
            if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() and IsBossUnit(enemy) then
                local dist = (enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - origin):Length2D()
                if not best or dist < best_dist then
                    best = enemy
                    best_dist = dist
                end
            end
        end
        if best then
            return best
        end
        return SelectClosestEnemy(enemies, origin)
    end
    if career_key == "warrior" then
        local best = nil
        local best_hp = nil
        local best_dist = nil
        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
            if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
                local hp = enemy:GetHealth()
                local dist = (enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - origin):Length2D()
                if not best or hp < best_hp or (hp == best_hp and dist < best_dist) then
                    best = enemy
                    best_hp = hp
                    best_dist = dist
                end
            end
        end
        return best or enemies[1]
    end
    if career_key == "ranged" then
        local best = nil
        local best_hp = nil
        local best_dist = nil
        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
            if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
                local hp = enemy:GetHealth()
                local dist = (enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - origin):Length2D()
                if not best or hp > best_hp or (hp == best_hp and dist < best_dist) then
                    best = enemy
                    best_hp = hp
                    best_dist = dist
                end
            end
        end
        return best or enemies[1]
    end
    return SelectClosestEnemy(enemies, origin)
end

local function ComputeCareerDamageBonus(profile, enemy, origin)
    if not profile or not enemy or enemy:IsNull() then
        return 0, nil, 0
    end
    local career = NormalizeCareer(profile.career)
    if not career then
        return 0, nil, 0
    end
    local cfg = GetCareerConfigTable(career)
    local dist = origin and (enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - origin):Length2D() or 0
    local is_boss = IsBossUnit(enemy) and 1 or 0
    if not cfg then
        return 0, dist, is_boss
    end
    local bonus = 0
    local career_key = string.lower(career)
    if career_key == "warrior" then
        local range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_range", "BonusRange", "Range", "range" }) or 0
        local pct = ReadCareerPct(cfg,
            { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        if range > 0 and dist <= range then
            bonus = pct
        end
    elseif career_key == "ranged" then
        local min_range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_min_range", "BonusMinRange", "MinRange", "min_range" }) or 0
        local max_range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_max_range", "BonusMaxRange", "MaxRange", "max_range" }) or 0
        local max_bonus = ReadCareerPct(cfg,
            { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        if max_range > min_range and dist > min_range then
            local t = math.min(1, (dist - min_range) / (max_range - min_range))
            bonus = max_bonus * t
        elseif dist >= max_range and max_range > 0 then
            bonus = max_bonus
        end
    elseif career_key == "control" then
        local requires_boss = ReadCareerBool(cfg,
            { "requires_boss", "RequiresBoss", "BossOnly", "boss_only", "IsBoss", "is_boss" })
        if requires_boss == 0 then
            requires_boss = 1
        end
        if requires_boss == 1 and is_boss == 1 then
            bonus = ReadCareerPct(cfg,
                { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        end
    elseif career_key == "mage" then
        profile.career_crit_chance_bonus_pct = ReadCareerPct(cfg, {
            "crit_chance_bonus_pct",
            "CritChanceBonusPct",
            "CritChancePct",
            "crit_chance_pct",
        }) or 0
    end
    return bonus, dist, is_boss
end

    local anim = kv.AbilityCastAnimation

        local act = _G[anim]

        end

        local act = _G[channel]

    if not gesture then

    end
    SyncVisualFacing(parent, face_pos)
    local list = GetVisualDummies(parent)
    if (not list or #list == 0) and parent then
        -- fallback to last known list in case formation list was refreshed mid-cast
        list = parent.__shop1_visual_dummies_last
        if (not list or #list == 0) and parent.__shop1_visual_main then
            local main = parent.__shop1_visual_main
            if main and not main:IsNull() then
                list = main.__shop1_visual_dummies_last or main.__shop1_visual_dummies
            end
        end
    end
    local entries = {}
    if list and #list > 0 then
        for _, dummy in ipairs(list) do
            if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                table.insert(entries, string.format("%s(alive=%s,start=%s)",
                    tostring(dummy:entindex()),
                    tostring(dummy:IsAlive()),
                    tostring(dummy.StartGesture ~= nil)))
            else
                table.insert(entries, "nil_or_null")
            end
        end
    end
    -- print(string.format(
    --     "[Shop1Dummy][Gesture] caster=%s name=%s visuals=%s last=%s main=%s list=%s gesture=%s",
    --     tostring(parent and parent:entindex() or "nil"),
    --     tostring(parent and parent.GetUnitName and parent:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
    --     tostring(list and #list or 0),
    --     tostring(parent and parent.__shop1_visual_dummies_last and #parent.__shop1_visual_dummies_last or 0),
    --     tostring(parent and parent.__shop1_visual_main and
    --         (parent.__shop1_visual_main:IsNull() and "null" or parent.__shop1_visual_main:entindex()) or "nil"),
    --     table.concat(entries, ","),
    --     tostring(gesture)
    -- ))
    if not list or #list == 0 then
        return
    end
    for _, dummy in ipairs(list) do
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
            if dummy.RemoveNoDraw then
                dummy:RemoveNoDraw()
            end
            if parent and parent.GetForwardVector and dummy.SetForwardVector then
                dummy:SetForwardVector(parent:GetForwardVector())
            end
            local prev = dummy.__shop1_last_gesture
            if prev and dummy.RemoveGesture then
                dummy:RemoveGesture(prev)
            end
            if prev and dummy.FadeGesture then
                dummy:FadeGesture(prev)
            end
            dummy.__shop1_last_gesture = gesture
            if gesture == ACT_DOTA_ATTACK and duration and duration > 0 then
                local attrs = dummy:FindModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
                if not attrs then
                    attrs = dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs", { prevent_death = 1 })
                end
                if attrs and not attrs:IsNull() then
                    autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackSpeedOverride(attrs, dummy, parent, duration)
                end
            end
            if dummy.StartGesture then
                local playback_rate = 1
                if gesture == ACT_DOTA_ATTACK and parent and parent.GetAttackSpeed then
                    playback_rate = parent:GetAttackSpeed(true) or 1
                end
                if dummy.StartGestureWithPlaybackRate then
                    dummy:StartGestureWithPlaybackRate(gesture, playback_rate)
                else
                    dummy:StartGesture(gesture)
                end
            end
            if duration and duration > 0 and dummy.FadeGesture then
                Timers:CreateTimer(duration, function()
                    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                        dummy:FadeGesture(gesture)
                    end
                    return nil
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function ResolveRangedProjectileConfig(source, fallback, ability)
    local kv = ReadUnitKV(source or fallback)
    local effect = kv and (kv.ProjectileModel or kv.ProjectileName) or nil
    local speed = tonumber(kv and kv.ProjectileSpeed or 0) or 0
    if source and source.GetUnitName then
        -- print("[Ranged Attack] Resolving projectile config from source",
        --     tostring(source:GetUnitName()), "effect=", tostring(effect), "speed=", tostring(speed))
    end
    if speed <= 0 and fallback and fallback.GetProjectileSpeed then
        speed = fallback:GetProjectileSpeed() or 0
    end
    if speed <= 0 then
        speed = 900
    end
    local radius = 0
    if ability and ability.GetAbilityKeyValues then
        local ability_kv = ability:GetAbilityKeyValues() or {}
        local values = ability_kv.AbilityValues or {}
        radius = tonumber(values.ProjectileRadius or values.ProjectileWidth or values.ProjectileSize or 0) or 0

    end

end

local function ShallowCopyTable(src)

        return out
    end
    for k, v in pairs(src) do
        out[k] = v
    end
    return out
end

local function HasEnhanceModifier(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(ENHANCE_ROUTER_ALL) do

        if mod and not mod:IsNull() then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function ResolveEnhanceAttacker(attacker)

    end
    local source_dummy = attacker.__autocast_source_dummy and EntIndexToHScript(attacker.__autocast_source_dummy)
    local actual_attacker = attacker
    if source_dummy and not source_dummy:IsNull() then
        if attacker ~= source_dummy and HasEnhanceModifier(source_dummy) then
            actual_attacker = source_dummy
        elseif not HasEnhanceModifier(attacker) and HasEnhanceModifier(source_dummy) then
            actual_attacker = source_dummy
        end
    end
    return actual_attacker, source_dummy
end

local function IsRangedEnhanceAttacker(attacker, source_dummy)
    if M.IsRangedAttacker(attacker) then
        return true
    end
    if source_dummy and not source_dummy:IsNull() and M.IsRangedAttacker(source_dummy) then
        return true
    end
    local owner = M.ResolveOwner(attacker)
    if owner and not owner:IsNull() and M.IsRangedAttacker(owner) then

    end
    return false
end

local function GetProcRecordTables(attacker)
    if not attacker or attacker:IsNull() then

    end

        attacker.__enhance_record_map = {}
        attacker.__enhance_record_order = {}
    end

end

function M.NewEnhanceUid(attacker, root_uid)
    if not attacker or attacker:IsNull() then

    end

    local frame = GetFrameCount and GetFrameCount() or 0

    if _G.DEBUG_ENHANCE_UID then

    end

    end
    record = tostring(record)
    local function store_on(unit, label)
        if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
            return
        end
        local records, order = GetEnhanceRecordTables(unit)
        if not records then
            return
        end
        records[record] = {
            uid = enhance_uid,
            root_uid = enhance_root_uid,
            time = GameRules:GetGameTime(),
        }
        table.insert(order, record)
        local max_records = 128
        while #order > max_records do
            local old = table.remove(order, 1)
            records[old] = nil
        end
        if _G.DEBUG_ENHANCE_UID then
            print(string.format("[EnhanceUID][RecordStore] unit=%s name=%s record=%s uid=%s root=%s from=%s",
                tostring(unit:entindex()),
                tostring(unit.GetUnitName and unit:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
                tostring(record),
                tostring(enhance_uid),
                tostring(enhance_root_uid),
                tostring(label or "attacker")))
        end
    end

    local source_dummy = attacker.__autocast_source_dummy and EntIndexToHScript(attacker.__autocast_source_dummy)
    if source_dummy and source_dummy ~= attacker then

    end

    if owner and owner ~= attacker then

    end
end

function M.ResolveEnhanceUidFromRecord(attacker, record)
    if not attacker or attacker:IsNull() or record == nil then
        return nil, nil
    end
    record = tostring(record)
    local function resolve_on(unit, label)
        if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local records = unit.__enhance_record_map
        if not records then

        end
        local entry = records[record]

        end
        if _G.DEBUG_ENHANCE_UID then

                tostring(unit.GetUnitName and unit:GetUnitName() or "nil"),

        end

    end
    local source_dummy = attacker.__autocast_source_dummy and EntIndexToHScript(attacker.__autocast_source_dummy)

        end
    end

        end
    end

end

    if not attacker or attacker:IsNull() or record == nil then

    end

end

            tostring(uid),
            tostring(root_uid)))
    end
    return uid, root_uid
end

        local entry = queue[1]
        local age = now - (entry.time or now)
        if age <= max_age then
            return entry
        end
        table.remove(queue, 1)
        if _G.DEBUG_ENHANCE_UID then
            print(string.format("[EnhanceUID][PendingDrop] attacker=%s uid=%s age=%.2f q=%s",
                tostring(attacker:entindex()),
                tostring(entry.enhance_uid),
                tonumber(age) or 0,
                tostring(#queue)))
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function M.PopPendingEnhance(attacker, enhance_uid)
    if not attacker or attacker:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local queue = attacker.__enhance_pending_queue
    if not queue or #queue == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    if not enhance_uid then
        local entry = table.remove(queue, 1)
        if _G.DEBUG_ENHANCE_UID and entry then
            print(string.format("[EnhanceUID][PendingPop] attacker=%s uid=%s root=%s q=%s",
                tostring(attacker:entindex()),
                tostring(entry.enhance_uid),
                tostring(entry.enhance_root_uid),
                tostring(#queue)))
        end
        return entry
    end
    if queue[1] and queue[1].enhance_uid == enhance_uid then
        local entry = table.remove(queue, 1)
        if _G.DEBUG_ENHANCE_UID and entry then
            print(string.format("[EnhanceUID][PendingPop] attacker=%s uid=%s root=%s q=%s",
                tostring(attacker:entindex()),
                tostring(entry.enhance_uid),
                tostring(entry.enhance_root_uid),
                tostring(#queue)))
        end
        return entry
    end
    for i = 2, #queue do
        local entry = queue[i]
        if entry and entry.enhance_uid == enhance_uid then
            table.remove(queue, i)
            if _G.DEBUG_ENHANCE_UID then
                print(string.format("[EnhanceUID][PendingPop] attacker=%s uid=%s root=%s q=%s",
                    tostring(attacker:entindex()),
                    tostring(entry.enhance_uid),
                    tostring(entry.enhance_root_uid),
                    tostring(#queue)))
            end
            return entry
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function M.CheckAndMarkProc(attacker, record, key)
    if not attacker or attacker:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if record == nil then
        return true
    end
    local records, order = GetProcRecordTables(attacker)
    if not records then
        return false
    end
    local rec = records[record]
    if not rec then
        rec = {}
        records[record] = rec
        table.insert(order, record)
    end
    key = key or "_default"
    if rec[key] then
        return false
    end
    rec[key] = true

    local max_records = 64
    while #order > max_records do
        local old = table.remove(order, 1)
        records[old] = nil
    end
    return true
end

function M.SelectTargetsAround(owner, center, range, count, avoid_target)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() then
        return {}
    end
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
        owner:GetTeamNumber(),
        center,
        nil,
        range,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
        FIND_ANY_ORDER,
        false
    )
    local targets = {}
    if not enemies then
        return targets
    end
    for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
        if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() and enemy:IsAlive() and enemy ~= avoid_target then
            table.insert(targets, enemy)
            if #targets >= count then
                break
            end
        end
    end
    return targets
end

function M.CreateLinearProjectileWithTrackingVisual(params)
    if not params then
        return nil
    end
    local effect_name = params.visual_effect or params.effect_name or params.EffectName or ""
    local linear_info = ShallowCopyTable(params.linear_info or {})
    local ability = params.ability or linear_info.Ability
    local source = params.source or params.owner or linear_info.Source
    local source_pos = params.source_pos or params.vSpawnOrigin or linear_info.vSpawnOrigin

    if not source or not source_pos then
        return nil
    end

    if M.IsLinearParticle(effect_name) then
        linear_info.Ability = linear_info.Ability or ability
        linear_info.Source = linear_info.Source or source
        linear_info.vSpawnOrigin = linear_info.vSpawnOrigin or source_pos
        if params.vVelocity and not linear_info.vVelocity then
            linear_info.vVelocity = params.vVelocity
        end
        if params.distance and not linear_info.fDistance then
            linear_info.fDistance = params.distance
        end
        if params.start_radius and not linear_info.fStartRadius then
            linear_info.fStartRadius = params.start_radius
        end
        if params.end_radius and not linear_info.fEndRadius then
            linear_info.fEndRadius = params.end_radius
        end
        linear_info.EffectName = effect_name
        linear_info.ExtraData = MergeExtraData(linear_info.ExtraData, params.linear_extra_data)
        local linear_proj_id = ProjectileManager:CreateLinearProjectile(linear_info)
        return {
            linear_proj_id = linear_proj_id,
        }
    end

    local team = params.team
    if not team then
        if source.GetTeamNumber then
            team = source:GetTeamNumber()
        elseif params.owner and params.owner.GetTeamNumber then
            team = params.owner:GetTeamNumber()
        end
    end

    local visual_source = params.visual_source
    local visual_source_idx = nil
    local visual_source_dummy = nil
    if not visual_source and team and (params.visual_source_pos or source_pos) then
        visual_source_dummy = M.AcquireTrackingTarget(team)
        if visual_source_dummy and not visual_source_dummy:IsNull() then
            visual_source_dummy:SetAbsOrigin(params.visual_source_pos or source_pos)
            visual_source_idx = visual_source_dummy:entindex()
            visual_source = visual_source_dummy
        end
    end

    local visual_target = params.visual_target or params.target
    local visual_target_idx = nil
    local visual_target_dummy = nil
    local visual_target_pos = params.visual_target_pos or params.target_pos
    if not visual_target and not visual_target_pos and params.direction and params.distance then
        visual_target_pos = source_pos + params.direction * params.distance
    end
    if not visual_target and team and visual_target_pos then
        visual_target_dummy = M.AcquireTrackingTarget(team)
        if visual_target_dummy and not visual_target_dummy:IsNull() then
            visual_target_dummy:SetAbsOrigin(visual_target_pos)
            visual_target_idx = visual_target_dummy:entindex()
            visual_target = visual_target_dummy
        end
    elseif visual_target and visual_target.entindex then
        visual_target_idx = visual_target:entindex()
    end

    if visual_source and visual_target_pos and visual_source.SetForwardVector then
        local dir = visual_target_pos - visual_source:GetAbsOrigin()
        dir.z = 0
        if dir:Length2D() > 0.01 then
            visual_source:SetForwardVector(dir:Normalized())
        end
    end

    if (not visual_source or not visual_target) and (visual_source_idx or visual_target_idx) then
        if visual_source_idx then
            M.ReleaseTrackingTarget(visual_source_idx)
        end
        if visual_target_idx then
            M.ReleaseTrackingTarget(visual_target_idx)
        end
        visual_source = nil
        visual_target = nil
        visual_source_idx = nil
        visual_target_idx = nil
    end

    local visual_info = nil
    if visual_source and visual_target and effect_name ~= "" then
        visual_info = {
            Target = visual_target,
            Source = visual_source,
            Ability = ability,
            EffectName = effect_name,
            iSourceAttachment = params.visual_attachment or DOTA_PROJECTILE_ATTACHMENT_NONE,
            iMoveSpeed = params.visual_speed or params.speed,
            bDodgeable = params.visual_dodgeable or false,
            bIsAttack = params.visual_is_attack or false,
            ExtraData = MergeExtraData({
                visual_only = 1,
                visual_target_idx = visual_target_idx,
                visual_source_idx = visual_source_idx,
            }, params.visual_extra_data),
        }
    end

    local visual_proj_id = nil
    local delay = tonumber(params.visual_delay or 0) or 0
    if visual_info then
        if delay > 0 then
            Timers:CreateTimer(delay, function()
                if not visual_info.Source or visual_info.Source:IsNull() then
                    return nil
                end
                if not visual_info.Target or visual_info.Target:IsNull() then
                    return nil
                end
                visual_proj_id = ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile(visual_info)
                if visual_info.ExtraData then
                    visual_info.ExtraData.visual_proj_id = visual_proj_id
                end
                return nil
            end)
        else
            visual_proj_id = ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile(visual_info)
            if visual_info.ExtraData then
                visual_info.ExtraData.visual_proj_id = visual_proj_id
            end
        end
    end

    linear_info.Ability = linear_info.Ability or ability
    linear_info.Source = linear_info.Source or source
    linear_info.vSpawnOrigin = linear_info.vSpawnOrigin or source_pos
    if params.vVelocity and not linear_info.vVelocity then
        linear_info.vVelocity = params.vVelocity
    end
    if params.distance and not linear_info.fDistance then
        linear_info.fDistance = params.distance
    end
    if params.start_radius and not linear_info.fStartRadius then
        linear_info.fStartRadius = params.start_radius
    end
    if params.end_radius and not linear_info.fEndRadius then
        linear_info.fEndRadius = params.end_radius
    end
    linear_info.EffectName = linear_info.EffectName or ""
    linear_info.ExtraData = MergeExtraData(linear_info.ExtraData, MergeExtraData(params.linear_extra_data, {
        visual_target_idx = visual_target_idx,
        visual_source_idx = visual_source_idx,
        visual_proj_id = visual_proj_id,
    }))
    local linear_proj_id = ProjectileManager:CreateLinearProjectile(linear_info)
    return {
        linear_proj_id = linear_proj_id,
        visual_proj_id = visual_proj_id,
        visual_target_idx = visual_target_idx,
        visual_source_idx = visual_source_idx,
    }
end

function M.CleanupLinearProjectileVisual(data, cache)
    if not data and not cache then

    local visual_only = data and data.visual_only
    local proj_id = nil

        proj_id = cache.proj_id
    end
    if data and data.visual_proj_id ~= nil then
        proj_id = data.visual_proj_id
    end
    if proj_id ~= nil and not visual_only then
        ProjectileManager:DestroyTrackingProjectile(tonumber(proj_id) or proj_id)
    end
    local target_idx = nil
    if cache then
        target_idx = cache.visual_target_idx or cache.target_idx or cache.dummy
    end
    if data and (data.visual_target_idx or data.visual_entindex) then
        target_idx = data.visual_target_idx or data.visual_entindex
    end
    if target_idx ~= nil then
        M.ReleaseTrackingTarget(target_idx)
    end
    local source_idx = nil
    if cache and cache.visual_source_idx then
        source_idx = cache.visual_source_idx
    end
    if data and data.visual_source_idx then
        source_idx = data.visual_source_idx
    end
    if source_idx ~= nil then
        M.ReleaseTrackingTarget(source_idx)
    end

function M.IsBusyByPassives(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    local source = unit
    if unit.__autocast_source_dummy then
        local src = EntIndexToHScript(unit.__autocast_source_dummy)
        if src and not src:IsNull() then
            source = src
        end
    end

    local count = source:GetAbilityCount()
    for i = 0, count - 1 do
        local ab = source:GetAbilityByIndex(i)
        if ab and not ab:IsNull() and ab:IsPassive() then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            for _, kw in ipairs(_G.BUSY_ENHANCE_KEYWORDS) do
                if string.find(name, kw) then
                    -- Check if it actually has a value (level > 0 effectively)
                    local count_val = tonumber(M.GetPassiveRawValue(ab, "count") or 0) or 0
                    if count_val > 0 then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

---
-- 通过 SP Dummy 施放衍生原版技能
-- 在 SP Dummy 的 modifier_dummy_autocast 上添加 profile（与其他技能相同的方式）
-- @param parent_mod modifier_dummy_autocast 实例（Main Dummy 的）
-- @param ability_name 原版技能名称
-- @param target_pos 目标位置（可选）
-- @param target_unit 目标单位（可选）
-- @param profile_params profile 参数（base_damage, damage_scale, no_damage 等）
-- @return sp_dummy, ability
function M.CastDerivedAbility(parent_mod, ability_name, target_pos, target_unit, profile_params)
    if not parent_mod or not ability_name or ability_name == "" then
        return nil, nil
    end

    print("[EnhanceUtils] CastDerivedAbility:", ability_name)

    -- 获取 SP Dummy
    local sp_dummy = parent_mod:AcquireDummySp(target_pos)
    if not sp_dummy or sp_dummy:IsNull() then
        return nil, nil
    end

    -- 在 Main Dummy (parent_mod) 上管理 profile
    -- SP Dummy 通过 __autocast_source_dummy 指向 Main Dummy，Filter 会读取 Main Dummy 上的 profile
    if profile_params then
        local profile = parent_mod:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name)
        if profile then
            -- 更新现有 profile
            profile.base_damage = profile_params.base_damage or 0
            profile.damage_scale = profile_params.damage_scale or 0
            profile.hit_origin = profile_params.hit_origin or ability_name
            profile.pure_percent = profile_params.pure_percent or 0
            profile.hit_kind = profile_params.hit_kind or "derived"
        else
            -- 注册新 profile
            parent_mod:InitProjectileProfile({
                name = ability_name,
                interval = profile_params.interval or 999, -- 大值防止自动施法
                base_damage = profile_params.base_damage or 0,
                damage_scale = profile_params.damage_scale or 0,
                pure_percent = profile_params.pure_percent or 0,
                hit_origin = profile_params.hit_origin or ability_name,
                hit_kind = profile_params.hit_kind or "derived",
            })
        end
    end

    -- 添加/获取技能
    local ability = sp_dummy:FindAbilityByName(ability_name)
    if not ability then
        ability = sp_dummy:AddAbility(ability_name)
    end
    if not ability then
        return sp_dummy, nil
    end
    ability:SetLevel(1)
    ability:SetActivated(true)

    if ability:GetAbilityName() == "dragon_knight_fireball" then
        sp_dummy:SetOrigin(target_pos)
    end

    -- 设置目标位置/单位（用于 OnSpellStart）
    if target_pos and sp_dummy.SetCursorPosition then
        sp_dummy:SetCursorPosition(target_pos)
    end
    if target_unit and sp_dummy.SetCursorCastTarget then
        sp_dummy:SetCursorCastTarget(target_unit)
    end

    -- 直接调用 OnSpellStart（无动画/前摇/后摇）
    ability:OnSpellStart()

    return sp_dummy, ability
end

---
-- 绘制调试范围圆圈
-- @param origin Vector 圆心位置
-- @param radius number 半径
-- @param duration number 持续时间（秒）
-- @param color Vector RGB颜色 (r, g, b)，值范围 0-255
-- @param label string 可选标签
function M.DebugDrawRange(origin, radius, duration, color, label)
    if not DEBUG_RANGE then
        return
    end

    if not origin or not radius or radius <= 0 then
        return
    end

    duration = duration or 3.0
    color = color or Vector(255, 0, 0) -- 默认红色

    -- 绘制圆圈（使用多个线段近似）
    local segments = 32
    local prev_point = nil
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = (i / segments) * 2 * math.pi
        local x = origin.x + radius * math.cos(angle)
        local y = origin.y + radius * math.sin(angle)
        local point = Vector(x, y, origin.z + 10) -- 稍微抬高避免z-fighting

        if prev_point then
            DebugDrawLine(prev_point, point, color.x, color.y, color.z, true, duration)
        end
        prev_point = point
    end
end

---
-- 从配置中获取范围并绘制调试圆圈
-- @param caster CDOTA_BaseNPC 施法者
-- @param ability_name_or_ability string|CDOTABaseAbility 技能名或技能实例
-- @param origin Vector 圆心位置
-- @param range_key string 范围键名（默认为 "radius"）
-- @param duration number 持续时间（默认 3 秒）
-- @param color Vector RGB 颜色（默认红色）
function M.DebugDrawRangeFromConfig(caster, ability_name_or_ability, origin, range_key, duration, color)
    if not DEBUG_RANGE then
        return
    end

    if not origin then
        return
    end

    range_key = range_key or "radius"

    -- 获取技能实例
    local ability = nil
    local ability_name = nil
    if type(ability_name_or_ability) == "string" then
        ability_name = ability_name_or_ability
        if caster and not caster:IsNull() then
            ability = M.GetPassiveAbility(caster, ability_name)
            if not ability then
                ability = caster:FindAbilityByName(ability_name)
            end
        end
    else
        ability = ability_name_or_ability
        if ability and not ability:IsNull() and ability.GetAbilityName then
            ability_name = ability:GetAbilityName()
        end
    end

    -- 尝试从多个来源获取范围值
    local radius = nil

    -- 1. 优先从 shop1_items_enhance_passive.txt 获取
    if ability_name then
        radius = M.GetPassiveConfigValue(ability_name, range_key)
    end

    -- 2. 如果没有，尝试从技能 KV 获取
    if not radius and ability and ability.GetSpecialValueFor then
        local success, value = pcall(function() return ability:GetSpecialValueFor(range_key) end)
        if success and value then
            radius = value
        end
    end

    -- 3. 如果还是没有，尝试从 AbilityKV 直接读取
    if not radius and ability_name and AbilityKV then
        local ability_kv = AbilityKV[ability_name]
